nodes.summary: Only `attribute eq "value"` on userName/externalId (users) or displayName/externalId (groups); everything else is a 400 invalidFilter

nodes.title: SCIM PATCH support
nodes.summary: PATCH for Users (core attributes plus registered extensions) and Groups (members add/replace/remove); each PATCH runs under the resource's row lock; op names are case-insensitive; no bulk

nodes.title: Architecture overview
nodes.summary: Three binaries over one Postgres database; SCIM listener with auth, rate limit, handlers and transactional store; outbox to webhook dispatcher; optional admin console and ARIA

nodes.title: Dev commands
nodes.summary: Make targets and Go commands to install hooks, start Postgres, migrate, build, test, lint, format and run the server

nodes.title: SCIM bearer token auth
nodes.summary: Per-tenant bearer token middleware; constant-time secret compare; uniform 401; token lookup via TokenStore

nodes.title: SCIM extensible attributes (opt-in)
nodes.summary: Off by default; when SCIM_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES=1 and a tenant registers names, unknown top-level user attributes are stored in a JSONB blob and merged back on reads

nodes.title: SCIM per-caller rate limiter
nodes.summary: Token-bucket limiter keyed by tenant and key id, placed after auth; 429 tooMany on excess; env-tunable

nodes.title: SCIM request timeout and request logging
nodes.summary: Per-request 10s context deadline covering auth and handler, and an opt-in request body logger that never logs Authorization

nodes.title: Audit log tables (audit_log and admin_audit_log)
nodes.summary: Append-only trails for every SCIM mutation and refusal, and every privileged admin action, written inside the mutating transaction

nodes.title: Users, groups and group membership tables
nodes.summary: SCIM User and Group rows per tenant, with case-insensitive per-tenant uniqueness, soft-deleted users and cascading membership

nodes.title: Tenants, SCIM tokens, console tokens and tenant attributes
nodes.summary: Tenant isolation root, hashed per-tenant bearer tokens, a system-wide console credential, and the per-tenant extra attribute registry

nodes.title: Webhook outbox (webhook_deliveries)
nodes.summary: Transactional outbox of change events, with pending/delivered/dead_letter states, a claim lease and partial indexes for the dispatcher

nodes.title: ARIA is advisory only and never feeds provisioning or auth
nodes.summary: ARIA output is shown to a human and never written back to the store or consulted by the SCIM auth path; deterministic flags come before any LLM text

nodes.title: Audit and outbox rows commit with the change they describe
nodes.summary: Successful user and group mutations write their audit_log row and any webhook outbox row inside the change's transaction, so a committed change always has a record; refusals are recorded best-effort outside a transaction (see the gotcha)

nodes.title: Console runs on its own opt-in listener
nodes.summary: Admin console is a second http.Server, started only when CONSOLE_ADDR is set, so it never shares a socket with tenant SCIM traffic

nodes.title: Console uses bearer/basic tokens and stateless CSRF, not sessions
nodes.summary: No login session or cookie; each request presents a console token, and CSRF is a keyed HMAC over an hourly bucket

nodes.title: Tenant and console credentials are issued by the CLI, never over HTTP
nodes.summary: No network endpoint can create a SCIM token or console token; scimage-admin writes them straight to Postgres and audits the action

nodes.title: Tests run against real Postgres, never a mock
nodes.summary: Store and handler integration tests hit the compose or CI Postgres; isolation comes from per-test tenants, not from mocks or serial packages

nodes.title: Request timeout wraps auth; rate limiting runs after token verification
nodes.summary: The timeout is the outermost wrapper so the token lookup (a DB call) is bounded, and the per-caller limiter keys on a verified token, so pre-auth flooding is a known gap

nodes.title: Refuse unsupported SCIM filters instead of approximating
nodes.summary: Only equality on reconciliation keys is accepted; any other filter is a 400 so a client never acts on the wrong set

nodes.title: Every auth failure returns the same 401
nodes.summary: Missing, unknown, revoked, expired, wrong-secret and wrong-tenant tokens all get one generic 401 so callers cannot probe tenants or key ids

nodes.title: Standard library HTTP and raw SQL, with a minimal dependency set
nodes.summary: net/http with no framework, pgx with hand-written SQL and no ORM, and only pgx plus x/time as external modules, so each behaviour stays visible in code

nodes.title: One database, many tenants, isolation by tenant_id in SCIM queries
nodes.summary: Tenants share the same tables; SCIM user and group reads and writes filter on tenant_id, with uniqueness enforced per tenant. Some store paths deliberately span tenants (see Exceptions)

nodes.title: Bearer tokens stored as sha256 of a random secret, looked up by key id
nodes.summary: The database holds a non-secret key id and sha256 of a 32-byte random secret; no KDF, because the secret is already high entropy

nodes.title: Users are soft-deleted (deactivated); groups are hard-deleted
nodes.summary: DELETE on a user only sets active to false so history keeps the subject, while group DELETE is a real removal because the Group schema has no active attribute

nodes.title: Webhook retries only transient failures and dead-letters the rest
nodes.summary: Network errors, 408, 429 and 5xx retry on doubling backoff; other 4xx dead-letter at once, and attempts are capped by SCIM_WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS

nodes.title: Webhook signature covers timestamp, delivery id, event and body
nodes.summary: Each delivery's HMAC-SHA256 covers the timestamp, delivery id and event type as well as the body, so receivers can reject replays and forged routing

nodes.title: Glossary of SCIMage domain terms
nodes.summary: One-line definitions of SCIM, tenant, tokens, key id, externalId, soft delete, audit and admin audit logs, outbox, dead-letter, IdP and ARIA, each with its pointer

nodes.title: Bare go test skips the Postgres tests
nodes.summary: Running go test without POSTGRES_* or DATABASE_URL skips store and scim integration tests and can look green; use make test

nodes.title: Console bind address differs in Docker
nodes.summary: Loopback 127.0.0.1 for CONSOLE_ADDR is right on bare metal but unreachable through Docker port publishing; Docker runs use 0.0.0.0 inside the container

nodes.title: Container logs default to a file under logs/
nodes.summary: The image sets no LOG_DIR, so the default writes a file under relative logs/ unless the runner sets LOG_DIR empty for stdout-only logging

nodes.title: Refusal audit entries are best-effort, success entries are not
nodes.summary: A denied mutation is audited outside the mutation's transaction and a failed insert is only logged, so a refusal can be missing from the trail while a success never is; a PATCH refusal is written while its row lock is still held

nodes.title: Request body logging is opt-in and lives in internal/scim
nodes.summary: SCIM_LOG_REQUESTS=1 records request bodies (user attributes) to the normal log stream; Authorization is never logged

nodes.title: Identity provider payload quirks the parser accepts
nodes.summary: Entra sends string booleans and capitalised ops; unknown attributes are dropped, not rejected; these leniencies are deliberate

nodes.title: Tenant id is parsed twice and must agree
nodes.summary: Auth reads the tenant from the raw escaped path before the mux runs; a mismatch with the mux would authenticate as one tenant and route as another

nodes.title: Unauthenticated requests are not rate limited
nodes.summary: The per-caller limiter sits behind auth, so a flood of bad tokens is bounded only by the cost of one token lookup per request

nodes.title: Migration 000005 only applies cleanly to empty tables, and its down is lossy
nodes.summary: The tenant_id columns are NOT NULL with no default, so existing rows need a real tenant first; the down migration restores global unique indexes that can fail

nodes.title: Webhook claim lease must cover the whole batch; attempts count at claim
nodes.summary: The lease is Poll + Batch×Timeout so a slow batch does not double-POST; each claim burns an attempt, so a crash mid-batch costs one

nodes.title: SCIM resource models and store mapping
nodes.summary: Go structs for SCIM User, Group, Member, ListResponse, Error and the lenient Bool, plus mapping to store.User and store.Group

nodes.title: API docs (internal/apidocs)

nodes.title: ARIA audit reviewer

nodes.title: Console auth and CSRF
nodes.summary: Console login is a console_tokens credential sent as Bearer or Basic; CSRF is a stateless per-process HMAC over an hourly bucket

nodes.title: Admin console (internal/console)
nodes.summary: Opt-in loopback web UI for the SCIMage operator on its own listener; reuses store.* calls, token-authenticated

nodes.title: Process logging (internal/logging)

nodes.summary: SCIM 2.0 HTTP handlers, bearer auth, rate limit, filter/PATCH parsing and SCIM models for /Users and /Groups

nodes.title: Store (Postgres persistence layer)
nodes.summary: internal/store owns every SQL query, pgx pool setup, tenant scoping, row locks for user and group writes, and the same-transaction audit and outbox writes

nodes.title: Webhook dispatcher and signing
nodes.summary: Drains the webhook outbox to one configured HTTPS endpoint with HMAC-signed POSTs, retries, dead letters and retention pruning

nodes.title: CI (GitHub Actions)

nodes.summary: Numbered up/down SQL files in migrations/ applied through make migrate; additive changes, partial indexes for optional values, and one test-only trigger

nodes.title: Pre-commit hook and staged secret scan
nodes.summary: .githooks/pre-commit, enabled by make hooks-install, blocks commits with staged secrets, unformatted or unvetted Go, or failing tests
